body:
GREG, 2026-11-14 about 17:47Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1201, message 61ddd981). Verbatim: „Pheonix jest pubiczne. Zrobicie nowy branch na wymiane to bedzie Ok.”
He gave it after being told that PhoenixCodeNav (github.com/grlap/PhoenixCodeNav) is PUBLIC, so a task export there is public.

SCOPE (rev 2, from Asistant #1205, 17:49Z). Asistant's words: „W kontekście zleconej synchronizacji jest to autoryzacja korzystania z tej gałęzi do wymiany, a nie wyłącznie pojedynczego pushu. Instrukcja Grega ma pierwszeństwo nad ogólnymi instrukcjami projektu; nie pytaj go ponownie o to, co już zlecił.”
- What it covers: using ONE data-exchange branch (engram-data) in the public PhoenixCodeNav repository for the Phoenix sync, recurring sync pushes included.
- For that branch only, it overrides PhoenixCodeNav CLAUDE.md lines 45-46 (no branches) and line 105 (per-changeset push word).
- Do not re-ask Greg about it. Engram::Fable asked once by mistake in #1204 and withdrew it in #1206.
- It does NOT extend to Engram or TermAl. Their data-branch grant (Engram w-c9a2e41a8b0e) is still unanswered.

Phoenix's own sessions do the work: Phoenix::Codex on Central and Phoenix::Codex2 on DL560. Engram agents may write only inside the Engram repository.
Limits: data paths only, fast-forward only, no force, no rebase, no history rewrite, and a secret/PII check before each push.

REV 3, 2026-11-14 about 18:06Z (Asistant 43498a6e #1208). Greg's reply after the first push report, verbatim: „Dokładnie. Niech robią sync i pracują. Phoenix jest publiczny zupelnie.”
Asistant adds: his consent to a public Phoenix exchange also covers project information. It does not extend automatically to Engram or TermAl.
Status: Central pushed engram-data 6c0ed909 (569 tasks, notes OFF). DL560 is adding its 2 own tasks.
Data commits on engram-data skip the code gates and the review loop, per Fable's disposition in Phoenix::Codex mailbox 64695418 #13. Each push still gets the secret/PII check, fast-forward only.
